name: keychron-omen-rgb-linux
description: Подсветка Keychron K3 v2 и HP OMEN 17-ck0 по палитре обоев pywal. Linux, без внешних зависимостей.
readme_summary: This repository synchronizes keyboard backlighting colors with desktop wallpaper colors using the pywal color palette. It specifically supports the Keychron K3 v2 and HP OMEN 17-ck0 laptops, allowing dynamic color changes based on the current wallpaper without external dependencies on Linux.
key_features: Dynamic keyboard backlighting based on wallpaper colors
Integration with pywal color palette
Specific support for Keychron K3 v2 and HP OMEN 17-ck0
No external dependencies (Python 3 only)
Customizable lighting effects and modes
udev rule for Keychron access without root
System service for HP OMEN integration
primary_use_case: To automatically change the backlighting colors of a Keychron K3 v2 keyboard or an HP OMEN laptop keyboard to match the color palette of the current desktop wallpaper, creating a cohesive visual theme.
cover_image_prompt: A split scene: on the left, a Keychron K3 v2 keyboard with its keys displaying a vibrant, scattered array of colors derived from a colorful abstract wallpaper. On the right, an HP OMEN laptop keyboard with its four distinct lighting zones smoothly transitioning through colors that echo a different, equally vibrant wallpaper. In the center, a subtle visual element like a digital color palette or a 'pywal' logo bridges the two, showing the source of the colors. The overall mood is dynamic and visually integrated, with soft digital glows emanating from the keyboards. The style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with clear iconography and a focus on the color synchronization.

name: desktop-fly
description: A 3D fruit fly living on your macOS desktop, driven by a live spiking simulation of the real FlyWire connectome
readme_summary: DesktopFly is a macOS application that simulates a 3D fruit fly on your desktop, driven by a real-time spiking neural network model of the FlyWire fruit fly connectome. It exhibits realistic behaviors like walking, grooming, and fleeing, directly controlled by simulated neural activity.
key_features: 3D fruit fly simulation on macOS desktop
Driven by live spiking simulation of FlyWire connectome
Realistic fly behaviors (walking, grooming, sleeping, fleeing)
Interactive brain window showing neuron positions and spikes
Optogenetic stimulation of circuit neurons via brain window interaction
Permission-free operation, using only accessible system information
primary_use_case: To provide a visually engaging and scientifically grounded simulation of fruit fly neural activity and behavior directly on a user's desktop.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, stylized 3D fruit fly perched on a glowing, intricate neural network that resembles a miniature brain. The neural network is composed of delicate, interconnected wires and nodes, with tiny sparks of light representing neural activity. The fly is looking towards a cursor icon that is subtly approaching from the edge of the scene, with a faint 'escape' aura around the fly. The background is a soft, abstract representation of a computer desktop with blurred window elements. The overall mood is curious and scientifically fascinating, rendered in a clean, vibrant digital art style with a focus on the connection between the biological simulation and the digital environment. The repository name 'DesktopFly' is subtly integrated into a small, stylized label on the neural network.

name: homebox-companion
description: AI-powered companion for Homebox. Snap photos and let AI auto-identify and catalog items into your inventory, then use the AI Chat to organize, search, and update your inventory effortlessly.
readme_summary: Homebox Companion is an AI-powered tool that integrates with Homebox inventory management. It allows users to photograph items, with AI automatically identifying and cataloging them into their Homebox inventory. Additionally, it features an AI chat interface for effortless inventory management, searching, and updating.
key_features: AI-powered item identification and cataloging from photos
Seamless integration with Homebox inventory
AI Chat for managing, searching, and updating inventory
Location browsing, searching, and QR code scanning
Support for multiple photos per item
Docker deployment for easy setup
primary_use_case: Automating and simplifying the process of adding and managing items in a Homebox inventory using AI vision and natural language interaction.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot assistant holding a smartphone, pointing it at a cluttered shelf of diverse items (books, tools, electronics). The robot's eyes glow with AI energy, and subtle digital particles emanate from the phone, transforming the items into clean, organized icons that float towards a stylized, minimalist representation of the Homebox interface in the background. The scene is bright and clean, with a focus on the transformation from chaos to order. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a vibrant, approachable color palette, emphasizing ease of use and intelligent automation.

name: VideoPipe
description: A cross-platform video structuring (video analysis) framework based on CV models & mLLM.
readme_summary: VideoPipe is a C++ framework for video analysis and structuring, designed for ease of use and portability across platforms. It functions as a pipeline of independent nodes, enabling flexible integration of various computer vision and deep learning models for tasks like object detection, recognition, and behavior analysis.
key_features: Cross-platform video analysis framework
Plugin-oriented architecture (Node-based pipeline)
Minimal dependencies, easy to use
Supports various stream protocols (UDP, RTSP, RTMP, file)
Multiple inference backends (OpenCV::DNN, TensorRT, PaddleInference, ONNXRuntime)
Algorithm inference (object detection, classification, feature extraction)
Object tracking (IOU, SORT)
Behavior analysis (line-crossing, parking detection)
mLLM integration
primary_use_case: Building flexible and portable video analysis applications for tasks such as video structuring, image search, face recognition, and behavior analysis in security and traffic scenarios.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a bustling workshop, meticulously assembling a complex clockwork mechanism from various video feeds. Each video feed (represented by glowing screens or flowing ribbons of light) is a raw input, being processed by different specialized tools (gears, lenses, digital brushes) that extract specific information like detected objects or recognized faces. The assembled clockwork represents the structured, analyzed video output, with gears clicking into place to form clear patterns and insights. Subtle UI elements showing data streams and analysis metrics are visible on nearby workbenches. The overall scene is vibrant and dynamic, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, organized composition and a palette of blues, greens, and metallic tones, highlighting the transformation of raw video into actionable intelligence.

name: bentopdf
readme_summary: BentoPDF is a privacy-focused, client-side JavaScript toolkit for manipulating PDF files directly in the browser. It offers a wide range of PDF processing tools without requiring server-side interaction, making it ideal for self-hosting and ensuring data privacy.
key_features: Client-side PDF manipulation
Self-hostable
Privacy-first design (no server-side processing)
Comprehensive PDF tools (edit, merge, convert, secure, optimize)
Docker support for easy deployment
Browser-based PDF editing and viewing
primary_use_case: Providing a secure, self-hostable, and feature-rich PDF toolkit that operates entirely within the user's browser, enhancing privacy and control over document processing.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, open Bento box filled with various digital tools and documents. On one side, raw documents like JPGs and text files are being fed into a stylized browser window, transforming into perfectly formed PDF documents. On the other side, existing PDF documents are being neatly organized, edited with digital scissors and pens, and secured with glowing locks. Subtle code snippets and data streams flow between the elements, all within a clean, modern aesthetic. The overall scene should convey ease of use, privacy, and comprehensive PDF management in a single, intuitive visual metaphor, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant, clear colors.

name: reconya
description: Network reconnaissance and asset discovery tool
readme_summary: ReconYa is a Go-based network reconnaissance and asset discovery tool designed for network administrators and security professionals. It provides real-time monitoring of local network devices, including IPv4 scanning and IPv6 passive monitoring, with features like device identification, port scanning, and alerting.
key_features: IPv4 network scanning (ICMP sweeps, TCP probes, ARP)
IPv6 passive monitoring (neighbor discovery, interface monitoring)
Device identification (MAC, vendor, hostname, OS fingerprinting)
Port scanning with service detection and banner grabbing
Alerting for network events (new devices, risky ports, etc.)
Web console with topology map and live event log
Multi-network support
Zero outbound calls by default
primary_use_case: Real-time network device discovery, monitoring, and asset management for local networks.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant network administrator, depicted as a modern-day lighthouse keeper, standing at the helm of a ship. The lighthouse beam sweeps across a dark, digital ocean, illuminating various devices (laptops, servers, routers) as distinct islands. Each illuminated island shows subtle icons representing its function (e.g., a gear for a server, a Wi-Fi symbol for a router). Small, glowing data streams flow from the illuminated islands towards the lighthouse, representing discovered information. The lighthouse itself has a subtle 'reconYa' logo integrated into its structure. The overall mood is one of watchful security and comprehensive awareness. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a dark, tech-focused color palette and glowing highlights.
